items.evidence: Runners are kind runner, 1 health at Normal, 3 u/s (x 19.9->17.9 in 40 ticks), and 15 spawn in wave 6 (15 lanes learned, 225 = 15x15 points). But they come one every 1 s, not 1.5 s: Easy seed 1, no shooting in wave 6, tick 6100 runners at x 7.9, 10.9, 13.9, 16.9, 19.9 (3.0 apart at 3 u/s = 60 ticks). lib.rs has RUNNER_EVERY = 60; CHANGES.md says so too.

HUD shows 'Wave 1 of 6' / 'Oleada 1 de 6' / 'Vague 1 sur 6'. A planned Normal seed-1 run is at 450 and still playing after wave 5 (tick 5000, 'Wave 5 of 6'); runner kill 450->465; it ends won at tick 6045 with 675. With shooting stopped at tick 5961 the last runner reaches the gate: won at tick 6400, gate 4, score 660. The builder's Easy script also wins with 2 runners through (gate 3, 645).

Language Right from English goes Spanish then French, Left goes back (it stops at the ends, no wrap). In French: title [Tenez la porte, Jouer, Réglages, Quitter]; settings [Réglages, Volume : 8, Langue : Français, Difficulté :, Normal/Facile/Difficile, Retour]; play [Score : 0, Vague 1 sur 6, Porte : 5]; paused [Pause, Reprendre, Titre]; won [Vous avez gagné, Score : 675, Entrée : titre]; lost [Vous avez perdu, Score : 30, Entrée : titre]. Frames of all six screens checked: all French.

Settings texts [Settings, Volume: 8, Language: English, Difficulty:, Normal, Back]: Difficulty is focus index 2, between Language and Back. Default normal. Left -> Easy (stays Easy), Right -> Hard (stays Hard); focus stays on it. Shown as Fácil/Dificultad: in Spanish and Facile/Difficile/Difficulté : in French; fr_settings.png shows it.

Seed 1, saved settings: Easy walkers health 1 and runners 1; Normal walkers 2 and runners 1; Hard walkers 3 (also when set in the same run before Start) and runners 2 (planned Hard run, tick 5900: runners health 2; it won with 675).

Set volume 6, French and Hard in one run: settings.json holds all three, and the next run starts with fr/6/hard and Hard walkers have 3 health. A settings.json in the old format {language: es, volume: 3} (and one with only volume 10) loads with those values and difficulty normal; walkers then have 2 health.
The state has "difficulty": "normal"/"easy"/"hard", and each walkers entry has "kind": "walker"/"runner". The README frame command wrote out.png; it and 9 other frames are valid PNGs, 800x480 each.

Re-checked every old item that passed: m01 title/JSON; m02 PNG 800x480; m03 title texts, Down+Enter opens Settings, Start gives wave 1/score 0/gate 5; m04 volume stops at 10 and 0; m06 persists, fresh folder gives 8/en/normal; m07 guard 6->12 in 60 ticks, clamps at 0/12; m08 bolts 24 ticks apart, 14 u/s, gone after x 19.97; m09 5 walkers 2.25 apart at 1.5 u/s; m11 gate 5->4 at tick 803, lost shows Score 30; m12 wave 2 at +180 ticks with 7 walkers, 'Wave 2 of 6'; m13 full clear won 675, Enter -> title; m14 pause freezes state, Resume continues, Title -> title; m15 same seed gives identical output, seed 8 gives other lanes; m16/m17 frames match the state and show focus; m18 tables + README; m19 README commands work as written.

CHANGES.md lists each change with its files (lib.rs, fr.json, game.json, settings.json, strings), what was checked headless and how, and what was wrong before (stale README paths, title not translated, missing shoot sound, win script).

defects: Wave 6 runners spawn every 1 s (RUNNER_EVERY = 60) instead of every 1.5 s.
README 'Checks' still says checks/win-script.txt wins with seeds 1 and 2; a later README section says it no longer wins (it doesn't: wave 6 was added).
The bolt pass-through bug from m10 is still there (hit test ignores the walker's movement in the same tick); this failed before the change and is not held against it.
The Language setting stops at French and doesn't wrap back to English (step, not cycle); Left goes back.
